paragraphs: Highland Electric Fleets sells fleet electrification as a service to school districts, municipalities and fleet operators. The company was founded in 2019.

Customers hand over the whole job, and Highland plans, procures, implements and optimizes the electric fleet on their behalf. A performance guarantee reimburses customers for down time if the fleet is not charged and route-ready. The commercial pitch is that an electric fleet can be operated at or below the cost of running a diesel one. Highland also secures grants and incentives on behalf of the agencies it works with.

The company serves as the Official Electric School Bus Provider of the LA28 Olympic and Paralympic Games and Team USA. It points to vehicle-to-grid work and to managing some of the largest electric school bus fleets in the country. Maintenance figures cited on the site come from Twin Rivers Unified School District, which operates 58 EV buses. The site also counts the states where it has operational and contracted projects.

quote.text: mission is to make electric fleets accessible and affordable for all.
